{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
duplicate_patients = df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)
duplicates_summary = df[duplicate_patients]['patient_id'].value_counts()

# Check how many unique patients and how many total rows
n_unique_patients = df['patient_id'].nunique()
n_total_rows = len(df)

# Check sample_seq for each duplicate patient to see if they have multiple entries
sample_seq_max = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()

# Identify which rows to keep: highest sample_seq per patient
df_sorted = df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False)
df_deduped = df_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Confirm deduplication worked
n_deduped = len(df_deduped)

# Print summary
print(f"Total rows: {n_total_rows}")
print(f"Unique patients: {n_unique_patients}")
print(f"Number of patients with multiple entries: {len(duplicates_summary)}")
print(f"Deduplicated rows: {n_deduped}")
print(f"Rows removed: {n_total_rows - n_deduped}")

# Check if any patient has more than one entry after deduplication
remaining_duplicates = df_deduped['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)
if remaining_duplicates.any():
    print("Warning: Some patients still have duplicates after deduplication.")
else:
    print("✅ No remaining duplicates after deduplication.")"}
